meta.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
meta.coverage: India, rain and drought: 22 ERA5 indices, monthly, CCKP area average over India's land.
meta.note: ERA5 reanalysis (Copernicus Climate Change Service, ECMWF), aggregated by the World Bank CCKP. Missing values (a fill code) are left empty.

cdd.name: cckp_cdd
cdd.label: Longest dry spell (consecutive days under 1 mm)
cdd.group: Longest dry spell (consecutive days under 1 mm)

cwd.name: cckp_cwd
cwd.label: Longest wet spell (consecutive days of 1 mm or more)
cwd.group: Longest wet spell (consecutive days of 1 mm or more)

prpercnt.name: cckp_prpercnt
prpercnt.label: Rainfall, per cent (CCKP: percent of total precipitation)
prpercnt.group: Rainfall, per cent (CCKP: percent of total precipitation)

r10mm.name: cckp_r10mm
r10mm.label: Days with 10 mm of rain or more
r10mm.group: Days with 10 mm of rain or more

r20mm.name: cckp_r20mm
r20mm.label: Days with 20 mm of rain or more
r20mm.group: Days with 20 mm of rain or more

r50mm.name: cckp_r50mm
r50mm.label: Days with 50 mm of rain or more
r50mm.group: Days with 50 mm of rain or more

spei12.name: cckp_spei12
spei12.label: Drought index, 12-month SPEI (below zero is drier than normal)
spei12.group: Drought index, 12-month SPEI (below zero is drier than normal)

rsdi20mm.name: cckp_rsdi20mm
rsdi20mm.label: Longest run of days above 20 mm in a month
rsdi20mm.group: Longest run of days above 20 mm in a month
